blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The P26.91 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, was won by a lone ticket holder, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). However, no bettor won the P120.56 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot also drawn by the PCSO on Thursday. The winning combination for Lotto 6/42 was 15-40-08-34-23-10, which secured the P26.91 million jackpot for one ticket holder. READ: Lotto results for Nov. 19, 2026 Meanwhile, the Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the combination 23-24-10-02-09-37. No ticket matched all six numbers, leaving the P120.56 million jackpot without a winner. Minor games The PCSO also […]...
